description: This file defines the ScssHelper class, providing methods to compile and manipulate SCSS/CSS styles, including color modifications such as darkening, lightening, and RGBA conversion. It leverages the ScssPhp library for processing SCSS syntax.
published: OrangeHRM\CorporateBranding\(any public class/interface if applicable, none explicitly stated)

classes.name: ScssHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to compile SCSS and perform color manipulations such as darken, lighten, and rgba conversions.

methods.name: getNewCompiler
methods.description: Creates and configures a new SCSS compiler instance with compressed output style.

methods.name: darken
methods.description: Darkens a given color by a specified amount using SCSS's darken function.

methods.name: lighten
methods.description: Lightens a given color by a specified amount using SCSS's lighten function.

methods.name: rgba
methods.description: Converts a color to RGBA format with a specified alpha transparency.

methods.name: isValidColor
methods.description: Validates if a string is a proper color value by attempting to lighten it.
